propositions: The transition command exposes two distinct force flags (--force for start-work gate bypass, --force-close for close gate bypass) while claim uses a single --force, creating spelling inconsistency and operator confusion.

Renaming --force-close to --force with clean break (no compatibility alias) requires explicit rejection of the retired flag in the hand-rolled parser to prevent silent no-ops when stale callers invoke the old spelling.

The force reason must be threaded through transition_compute as a force_reason keyword to prefer explicit --force=<reason> over --reason text for start-work audit notes, preserving backward compatibility for --force --reason=X invocations.
Bare --force on a close transition must record the reason as (no reason given), matching claim behavior and ensuring parity across gate-bypass commands.
Concurrent changes landing after the rename (dependency_audit.py, canary_bridge.py) must emit the new --force spelling to avoid CommandError at runtime when the parser's rejecting branch fires.
